# Jack Jaillet

> Personal site of Jack Jaillet (he/him), a business student at UMass Amherst's Isenberg School of Management (class of 2030, Dean's Academy), owner of Charming Memories Photography, Leo Advisor for Lions District 33A, and the 2024-25 Massachusetts Leo of the Year. Based in Massachusetts.

Contact: contact@jackjaillet.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jackjaillet/

## Pages

- [About](https://jackjaillet.com/about): background, where Jack has been involved, and why he does the work
- [Resume](https://jackjaillet.com/resume): experience, activities, volunteer work, education, awards, skills and certifications
- [Services](https://jackjaillet.com/services): Signature Studio (a free email signature builder) and photography and video
- [Signature Studio](https://jackjaillet.com/signatures/): the free, open-source email signature builder Jack made
- [Blog](https://jackjaillet.com/blog/): longer writing (no posts yet)

## Key facts

- Education: UMass Amherst, Isenberg School of Management, Bachelor of Business Administration candidate, May 2030; Dean's Academy; hoping to major in Operations & Information Management with a double major in hospitality. Montachusett Regional Vocational Technical School, Business Technology, 2022-2026 (class treasurer and vice president, National Honor Society secretary, Leo Club president 2024-25)
- Owner, Charming Memories Photography (since November 2024): photography and video for families and organizations
- Client Service Associate, Bright Future Financial LLC, Leominster, MA (since May 2026; intern from February 2025)
- Consultant, Gathering Currents (since September 2025; youth consultant July-August 2025)
- Founder, LGBTQIA+ Safe Zone (since April 2021), now a registered 501(c)(3)
- Lions Clubs International: District 33A Leo Advisor (since June 2026), Student Leo Representative (2025-26), Fitchburg Lions Club member; Massachusetts Leo of the Year 2024-25
- Massachusetts Youth Leadership Foundation: Conference Multimedia Director for MassSTAR 2025 and 2026, board member November 2025 to August 2026
- Certified Trainer, Training Active Bystanders

Updated November 2026.
